explication: Helm Diff is a Helm plugin that previews Kubernetes resource changes, primarily by comparing a deployed release with a chart rendered for an upgrade. Its commands also compare release revisions, preview rollbacks, and compare two local charts. The graph follows the command entry points into Helm-backed manifest acquisition, manifest parsing and optional live-object merging, then diff computation and report output. README capabilities are included, but unsampled command implementations are represented only at their supported source paths; their internal wiring is not inferred.
